'''Joyce Chepchumba''' (born 6 November 1970 in [[Kericho]]) is a [[Long-distance track event|long distance]] [[Athletics (sport)|athlete]] from [[Kenya]], who won a bronze medal in marathon at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]].

== Achievements ==
*1995
**[[Tilburg Ten Miles]] winner
**[[Parelloop]] 10Kwinner<ref>Arrs.net: [https://www.arrs.run/HP_Pll10.htm List of Parelloop winners]</ref>
*1997 
**[[London Marathon]] winner
*1998 
**[[Chicago Marathon]] winner
*1999 
**London Marathon winner 
**Chicago Marathon winner
**[[Berlin Half Marathon]] winner
**[[Great North Run]] winner
*2000 
**[[Tokyo International Women's Marathon]] winner 
**[[2000 Summer Olympics]] [[bronze medal]]list 
**[[Berlin Half Marathon]] winner
*2001
**[[Berlin Half Marathon]] winner
*2002
**[[New York City Marathon]] winner
*2004
**[[Lisbon Half Marathon]] winner
**[[Berlin Half Marathon]] winner
